faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Biswanath Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Driver post is 19th September 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class X and possess a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving license to be eligible for the Driver position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Driver post is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Driver position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Driver post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Skill/Driving Test followed by an Interview/Viva-Voce.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it, and send it to the mentioned address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Driver in the District Legal Services Authority Biswanath.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a contractual Driver position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Biswanath, which is https://biswanath.dcourts.gov.in/.
